scope: asset-backed offline CPU keyboard/input/collision; headless Roam with native intro skip; synthetic fixed-step host scheduling only; no physical device/render/bot/network acceptance

conditions.landingPressPolicy: tick numbers 1-based; before/on/after native collision landing; no production buffering
conditions.manualHopSchedule: one-tick pulses every native firstLanding ticks (first step after previous collision landing)
conditions.movingHopSchedule: W except jump ticks; first Space pulse tick49, subsequent one-tick pulses on first observed grounded step with previous Space released; each run follows actual collision contact
conditions.traversal: W ticks1-120; D ticks61-180; S ticks181-220; Space ticks49,141
